evidence_basis: wire (anonymous session)
reason: Shared caching of a personalized response is PROVEN on the wire: /api/notifications/count answered HIT, HIT, HIT with age up to 43s while carrying "s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=300". The cache key is the URL alone — no response varied on Cookie or Authorization — so the stored entry is served to every caller of this URL regardless of which session produced it. The verdict is held at latent-hazard rather than leak-confirmed only because the two-account observation was blocked: COOKIE_A/COOKIE_B were not supplied. Treat as Critical.

evidence_basis: static (vercel.json path rule + probed path samples on the same prefix)
reason: Not user-specific, but not public either: anonymous callers receive 401, while an authorized caller's 200 carries "s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=300". Because the cache key ignores the session, a 200 generated for an authorized caller can be stored and then served to an unauthorized one. Auth is enforced in the handler, which the shared cache sits in front of.
